The pre-registered confirmatory OLS of tensile_mpa on carbon_pct plus lab indicators on held-out data gave estimate -0.204 (SE 0.115), p = 0.076, which is not significant at alpha = 0.05. Therefore no direct effect is confirmed.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
cands = ['anneal_temp','cool_rate','carbon_pct','chromium_pct','grain_size','humidity','press_time','nickel_pct','porosity','cure_hours']
# interaction with lab
for c in cands:
    d = df[['tensile_mpa','lab',c]].dropna().copy()
    X = pd.get_dummies(d[['lab',c]], columns=['lab'], drop_first=True).astype(float)
    for lab in ['lab_b','lab_c','lab_d']:
        X[f'{c}_x_{lab}'] = d[c]*(d['lab']==lab).astype(float)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    m = sm.OLS(d['tensile_mpa'], X).fit()
    # joint test of interactions
    inter = [f'{c}_x_{l}' for l in ['lab_b','lab_c','lab_d']]
    f = m.f_test(" = 0, ".join(inter)+" = 0")
    print(f"{c:14s} main p={m.pvalues[c]:.3f} inter joint p={f.pvalue:.3f}")

    f = m.f_test(" = 0, ".join(inter)+" = 0")
    print(f"{c:14s} main p={m.pvalues[c]:.3f} inter joint p={f.pvalue:.3f}")
"}
